name: elgato-handy-model-picker
description: Stream Deck plugin for macOS: one key per Handy speech-to-text model. Press to make it Handy's active model.
author: Robert Wayne (https://github.com/RobertTheNerd)

scripts.check: npm run format:check && npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run validate
scripts.restart: pkill -f com.robert.handy-model-picker.sdPlugin/bin/plugin.js; echo 'Stream Deck relaunches the plugin automatically'
scripts.pack: npm run build && mkdir -p dist && streamdeck pack com.robert.handy-model-picker.sdPlugin --output dist --force
